propositions: transport.py chronically exceeds 800-line cap due to reactive splits that do not establish permanent operation homes, forcing repeated rescue trims.
Extracting retry.py and transitions.py as re-exports did not reduce transport.py growth because new operations lack an obvious non-transport destination.
Capability Protocol boundaries in _backend.py (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe) provide a natural organising seam that aligns code location to operation intent.

Splitting transport.py into capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) composes into a single JiraDataCenterTransport class, preserving isinstance/Protocol conformance and all caller contracts.
JiraDataCenterTransport as a mixed composition maintains one cache, one _call_logged wrapper, and one self across all capabilities, avoiding delegation fragmentation.
